visual_action: The video is a montage showing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and U.S. President Donald Trump. It opens with Netanyahu writing in a book. A close-up reveals a handwritten note to Trump dated September 15, 2025, calling him Israel's greatest friend. Subsequent shots show Trump and Netanyahu talking in the Oval Office, walking together down a hallway, and speaking at separate events. The video includes shots of American and Israeli flags. It concludes with a black-and-white image of the White House building, followed by Marine One, with the text 'THE WHITE HOUSE' overlaid.
